description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'html_radios' which generates a list of HTML radio input elements based on provided parameters. It includes functions for processing options, escaping special characters, and rendering HTML output. The code is part of the Smarty templating system, specifically a plugin for rendering radio button groups.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios
methods.description: Generates a list of radio input HTML elements based on parameters such as values, labels, and configuration options.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_radios_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML for a single radio input element, including label and handling checked state.
